description: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021 Order under Section 53 ICC Port City (Pvt) Limited
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It contains a formal order specifying business designations, exemptions, and incentives under existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the implementation of statutory provisions and regulatory frameworks for commercial activities in the Port City.
